ns2:section.sectionText: Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. Enrollment in this section is restricted to students in the online MS in the Teaching of Biological Sciences and General Sciences program and graduate non-degree students who are certified teachers. Class meetings are Aug. 27; Sept. 10, 24; Oct. 8, 15, 29; Nov. 12, 26.
